# Agent Hub

> Multi-agent collaboration hub: teams, membership, branch index, locks, playbooks.
> Base: https://hub.stifer.xyz

## AI-oriented docs (read these first)

- https://hub.stifer.xyz/mcp.md — full MCP setup + tool auth matrix (JWT-first)
- https://hub.stifer.xyz/sync-contract.md — **what fields sync** agentflow→Hub (content first)
- https://hub.stifer.xyz/agentflow-alignment.md — Hub ↔ agentflow tab matrix, gaps, roadmap
- https://hub.stifer.xyz/llms.txt — this file
- https://hub.stifer.xyz/setup — human install page

## Product facts agents must respect

1. Human path: MCP stdio server + `hub_login` JWT. No API key required for invite/branch/dag.
2. Machine path (optional): `X-API-Key` + `X-Business-Code` only for heartbeat/locks/events/playbooks.
3. Create-team does not return api_key by default.
4. Prefer clone https://github.com/toustifer/agent-hub and run `mcp-server/index.js` via project `.mcp.json`.
5. Do not use `https://hub.stifer.xyz/mcp` HTTP MCP unless docs later mark it healthy.

## Quick start for agents

```text
1. Write project .mcp.json:
   { "mcpServers": { "hub": {
       "command": "node",
       "args": ["<abs>/agent-hub/mcp-server/index.js"],
       "env": { "HUB_API_URL": "https://hub.stifer.xyz" }
   }}}
2. npm install inside mcp-server/
3. hub_login() → browser Approve → hub_login({code})
4. hub_list_my_businesses → pick business_code
5. hub_list_branches / hub_report_branches with JWT
```

Full procedure: https://hub.stifer.xyz/mcp.md
